theme_strategy: Light mode preferred, but with dark mode support. For this industrial CRM context, the preferred approach is 'Swiss Brutalist' - a high-contrast layout emphasizing structural lines, pure black and white surfaces, and bright functional color accents.

typography.instructions: BANNED: Inter/Roboto/Open Sans for headings. Use IBM Plex Sans for that technical, print-shop precision feel. Keep line-height tight for headers, loose for body. Maximum fluid size for H1 is text-5xl.

colors.instructions: Color is Function Only. 95% of the UI should be monochrome. Use the 'accents_for_data' selectively for metrics, charts, or tagging to represent the CMYK print industry context. Never use pure #000000 or #808080 without a slight blue/orange tint.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Expose the skeleton. Use container layout with border-collapse and 1px border-border/40 on the right and bottom of grid items to create a dense dashboard feel.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Replace soft shadows with 1px solid strokes. Tactical Minimalism.
visual_enhancers.radius: Sharp edges. rounded-none or maximum rounded-sm (4px) across all components.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: If used (e.g., sticky header), MUST have background opacity (bg-white/70) and backdrop-blur-xl. NEVER use complete transparent background in header or dropdowns.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_mode: High Density Grid. Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap tight (gap-4 or gap-px if using border-collapse).
grids_and_layouts.estimating_view: F-pattern layout. Top-left for primary KPI (Amount Due/Estimate Total), top row for KPIs, main body for structured line-item tables.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing inside containers. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision. Mobile-first grids always.

components.name: Navigation & Sidebar
components.instructions: Collapsible left navigation with icon-only shrink states. Ensure the header has a solid or glassmorphism background (never transparent).

components.name: Quotes / Estimating Builder
components.instructions: Use Shadcn Table. Dense layout for line items, inputs nested in cells. Avoid heavy cards.

components.name: Materials Database / Catalog
components.instructions: Grid view for materials using the High Density Grid. Display cost/pricing prominently.

components.name: Invoicing & Financial Dashboards
components.instructions: Use Tables over charts for exact billing. Show top summary KPIs for AP/AR. Provide Xero-compatible CSV export button (distinct CTA).

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white). Darken border color.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties (transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease). DO NOT use transition: all.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Subtle interactions like 1px border shift or slight lift (-translate-y-px) on card hover.

accessibility.contrast: Normal text minimum 4.5:1. Large text 3:1. Interactive states must maintain high contrast.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have HIGHER contrast (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='add-line-item-btn').

media_and_icons.instructions: Use Phosphor Icons for a crisp, dense dashboard look. Install using `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react`.

login_hero.description: Sign shop environment for contextual login page.

material_vinyl_swatches.description: Colorful paper/vinyl swatches for material catalog items.

material_printer.description: Wide format printer for equipment or production view placeholders.

3d_libraries.decision: Not recommended for this CRM/ERP. Focus on clear 2D data visualization using Recharts or Shadcn chart components.
3d_libraries.instructions: Data density and clarity take priority over immersion. Avoid heavy 3D canvases.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You are building a Sign Shop CRM/ERP with Estimating, Materials DB, Invoicing, AP/AR, and a Customer Reorder Portal.
Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Implement a 'Swiss Brutalist' design: monochrome structures, exposed grid lines, high contrast typography, with CMYK-inspired accent colors for data points.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use .tsx. Use .js or .jsx files. Provide the guidelines and components for JavaScript React.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers, overlays, or dropdowns. Always use bg-background or backdrop-blur.
DO NOT use generic centered layouts. Left-align dense data, labels, and forms. .App { text-align: center; } is banned.
DO NOT apply 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transition properties.
Use sharp, modern button styles (rounded-none or max rounded-sm) matching the industrial theme.
NEVER use AI assistant emojis (🤖, 💡, 🔮) as icons. Use the Phosphor Icons library exclusively.
All interactive elements and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-estimate-btn').
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts, but utilize Shadcn UI components (heavily customized for JS) for forms, inputs, dialogs, and tables.
Ensure the Xero export button and Estimates builder are distinct and highly accessible.
If creating a customer portal vs internal CRM view, use the same design system but adjust the complexity (simpler cards for customers, dense tables for staff).
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: Ensure a frictionless F-pattern scanning experience for financial dashboards. Place top-level metrics (Total Receivables, Pending Estimates) at the top left. Use progressive disclosure: show summary cards first, then allow drill-down into detailed line-item tables. Color should exclusively communicate state (Success/Warning/Destructive) or differentiate chart series, not for decoration. Respect spacing: dense does not mean cramped; use adequate padding inside bounded containers.
